break-loop.subject: a row of four cyan crystals with a broad bronze bar slammed down between the second and third, the first two glowing amber; a small spark where the bar lands

job-sequencing.subject: three small brass tags on hooks in a line, the middle tag larger and gilded, a cyan crystal bolt pinned to it with a ribbon

boyer-moore.subject: a bronze ballot box with three crystals dropping in, two amber and one cyan, and a single large amber crystal rising out of its slot

stock-trader.subject: a zig-zag bronze line chart made of rods, each rising segment capped by a small amber crystal, a large amber crystal at the top right end

brace.subject: a small bronze kite shield made of three stacked pale cyan crystal shards, the smallest at the top, a bold rim around them

heapify.subject: a small bronze binary tree of seven sockets, the largest amber crystal in the top socket, smaller cyan crystals below, one curved arrow showing a crystal sifting down

increase-key.subject: a small cyan crystal on a bronze lift platform rising beside a tall amber crystal, a broad upward arrow beneath it

heap-sort.subject: a bronze funnel shaped like an upside-down tree, crystals entering at the top in a jumble and leaving at the bottom in a neat row from small to large

fractional-knapsack.subject: a large amber crystal sliced cleanly in two by a bronze cleaver, the bigger half slotted into a small leather knapsack, the smaller half floating beside it

minimum-arrows.subject: one long bronze-fletched crystal arrow passing through three floating soap-bubble orbs in a line, each orb bursting into shards

nearest-neighbour.subject: a bronze compass rose with one cyan crystal at its centre and a gold needle pointing at the nearest of three small dots around it

task-scheduler.subject: a bronze conveyor with crystals alternating amber, cyan, violet, amber, cyan, and a tiny empty grey gem in one gap
